title: Windows 11 preview update results in invalid certificate error - timezone change
creator: evilspoons
content:
Hi there.

I'm in Alberta, where we have recently changed timezones. Note that the CLOCK has not changed yet, as we are still before the date in November when we would "fall back". We were UTC-6 summer and UTC-7 winter. Windows called this "Mountain Time (USA and Canada), but now the "Mountain Time (Alberta)" timezone is in Windows after the 2026-09 Preview Update (KB5124010) (26300.9550).

When connecting to Shaw.ca's IMAP servers, the certificates that were valid prior to the Windows update are now reported as invalid. This has been confirmed across two separate PCs with different email accounts. The data for the certificate LOOKS valid (see screenshot) and is the same before and after the timezone change.

The failure occurred on the latest ESR release of Thunderbird, as well as 156.0 and 157.0 non-ESR.

Thanks :)

content:

title: Problemi di ricezione mail
creator: omega62
content:
Buongiorno, Premetto che faccio gestire a Thunderbird 5 account di posta, 2 di libero.it, 1 con yahoo.com, 1 con gmail.com e 1 pec con le poste, Thunderbird ha sempre funzionato bene ma da qualche settimana non scarica sempre la posta dal server di libero.it, invece gli altri account funzionano benissimo.

Succede che durante la giornata prevalentemente non scarica in automatico la posta dal server di libero.it, se forzo la richiesta manualmente sembra che si colleghi al server ma non preleva nessuna mail nonostante ci siano dei messaggi non scaricati, poi andando a vedere la posta in arrivo 1 o 2 volte al giorno mi ritrovo con qualche messaggio nuovo che ha prelevato dal server (non tutti) . In questi giorni invece appena apro il programma o forzo manualmente la richiesta di mail si apre una finestra che dice di inserire la pass del miei account di libero, le inserisco ma mi dice che sono errate nonostante siano corrette. Cosa posso fare per risolvere il problema? Non vorrei cancellare e reistallare il programma perchè ho delle date in agenda e delle mail e sottocartelle che mi servono.

title: multiple problems with thunderbird handling gmail accounts
creator: joel.kovarsky
content: For the last few months (several updates to Thunderbird) we are having a terrible time with our gmail accounts in Thunderbird. I am not that tech savvy, but so far nothing has worked (including a Thunderbird uninstall and reinstall). All server settings appear fine, and set to OAuth. We get random extra folders, random deleted folders, trouble with getting copies to sent mail (subscribe OK; have to go to Google's webmail site). This ONLY appears to be a problem with our iMac (M1 chip), and is not occurring with our Macbook Air (M2 chip). I've attempted a few other suggestions thrown up online, but I'm reluctant to tamper too much, and we are increasingly forced to rely on the Google webmail site for adequate function while on the iMac (again, MacBook Air is mostly OK).

title: data destructive bug
creator: Fred.Leonard4
content:
I had my dad on Thunderbird, and migrated him to Evolution, after your horrible failure. I only wish there was a Mac version, I'm stuck on Thunderbird on my Macs. There is no way I can trust Thunderbird, after this destructive failure. They tried to force people off of apt, Linux, and put in hooks to have apt use SNAP, want it or not! When it force migrated him off of apt, which was NOT wanted, or asked for, it lost ALL of his Thunderbird data.

Not only are you not smart enough to realize that some people don't want SNAP, AppImage, FlatPak, or other crap sandboxed garbage, but, without giving them a choice, trying to force a screwed up migration, that obviously doesn't work, and deleting ALL of their data is unacceptable. Even if it hadn't lost all of his data, it wasn't wanted, and I would have had to undo the damage.

FIreFox is the same shit, forcing to SNAP garbage. Fortunately, I have him on Brave, so it's not really needed, just installed for backup, but not being used.

I had to create install scripts just to get them to install normally, no SNAP GARBAGE! It was not easy, because they still try to force migrate.

There are a lot of authors now coming to Linux, that know nothing about it, and don't know how to use apt, so they try that sandboxed shit, not understanding that's why a lot of people are abandoning Windows and Mac in the first place. But most, if not all of them, at least have a .deb to download, or options. This is the first software I have seen trick apt into installing SNAP, then deleting all of its data. And, yes, after searching the entire drive, the data was gone.

What you did is complete BS, and unlike some of those newer people moving to Linux, you can't blame ignorance, because you are not new.

title: Hello,  I am having a problem with Thunderbird on Windows when connecting my Gmail/Google Workspace account through IMAP.
creator: it70
content:
Hello,

I am having a problem with Thunderbird on Windows when connecting my Gmail/Google Workspace account through IMAP.

The Google account authentication completes successfully and Thunderbird appears to connect to the account, but no email messages are displayed in the Inbox.

Here is what I have checked so far:

I am using Thunderbird on Windows. The email account is a Gmail/Google Workspace account. The account has been added to Thunderbird successfully. I signed in through Google's normal authentication/OAuth process. The account shows as connected in Thunderbird. IMAP is enabled and working on the Gmail side. Gmail webmail works normally and all my emails are visible there. Thunderbird displays the account and its folders. However, the Inbox contains no messages at all. I have checked the Subscribe section, but it does not show additional folders that I can subscribe to. I have already removed and re-added the account. I have also completely uninstalled and reinstalled Thunderbird and signed in again. The same problem remains after the fresh installation. The problem is therefore not simply that the account cannot authenticate; Thunderbird appears to connect, but it is not downloading/displaying the messages.

I would like to understand what could be preventing Thunderbird from synchronizing the Gmail IMAP mailbox.

Could this be related to:

Thunderbird's IMAP synchronization/cache, the Gmail IMAP folder/root settings, the Thunderbird profile, an IMAP subscription issue, OAuth2 authentication, Gmail's IMAP labels/folder mapping, or a corrupted Thunderbird preference/profile setting?

I would appreciate detailed troubleshooting steps to determine why Thunderbird can connect to the Gmail account but does not populate the Inbox with messages.

I can provide screenshots of the Account Settings, Server Settings, Synchronization & Storage, Gmail IMAP settings, or Thunderbird error/connection logs if required.

Thank you.
